title: Vaccine: Search For The Zombie Cure - Escape Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Ever wondered if you have what it takes to save the world from global pandemic... in this post-apocalyptic virus-infested escape room trap you will find out - if you dare.

Vaccine is a mission-based escape game trap Your mission is to enter into an old abandoned house believed to contain a vaccine to the zombie disease and find it. Then, escape outside to administer it before time runs out.
